messages:
Kai: Heads-up — I'm going to start a dry-run for the 'operator preview' activation thresholds on service-config. Want ops + console folks to eyeball sampling/telemetry before we open to product teams.
Marta: Thanks Kai. quick q — are we doing uniform sampling or cohort-based?
Kai: Cohort-based. intention is to start at cohort=0.1% and ramp to 1% over 24h if no errors.
Simon: Would prefer an initial holdback cohort for SLO-sensitive routes (payment, auth). 0.1% across all routes still risky.
Anya: Agreed. console should show per-route exposure + a per-cohort rollback button. otherwise ops will be calling us at 2am. :grimacing:
Kai: good call. plan: default sample_rate=0.001, but routes tagged critical get sample_rate=0.0001. telemetry will emit: preview.exposure.cohort, preview.errors, preview-latency.
Marta: can we include the preview config in the API response so customers using the preview API see which cohort they hit? small opt-in field like preview_meta.cohort_id
Kai: yes. sample response add-on: ```json
{"preview_meta": {"cohort_id": "c-412", "activation_ts": 1758765432}}
```
Simon: ops-bot, can you run the dry-run job on staging with that config and push telemetry to the dashboard?
ops-bot: scheduled dry-run on staging (job id: dr-1758765432). streaming preview.* metrics to staging-telemetry. ETA 6m. :white_check_mark:
Anya: UX thought — console preview panel should show a single-line summary (cohort, pct, active routes) + an expand for recent sample logs. We should add a quick 'abort cohort' CTA with a one-click rollback that also annotates audit logs.
Marta: question on TTLs — how long do we keep cohort assignment? if TTL too long users see preview behavior for days. I'd vote 1h default and ability to pin per test.
Kai: default TTL=3600s. pin option is admin-only. we'll add a TTL field in the config: ```yaml
preview:
  enabled: true
  sample_rate: 0.001
  ttl_secs: 3600
```
Simon: telemetry alert thresholds? suggest preview.errors > 0.5% or p95 latency +50ms triggers an auto-pause.
Kai: auto-pause rule will be: error_rate_delta >= 0.5% OR p95_delta >= 50ms over 5m window. auto-pause posts to #release-war-room and creates a runbook stub.
Anya: make sure the console surfaces the auto-pause reason and links to the roll-forward checklist. also soft-announce to affected product teams in the UI.
Marta: last nit — we need a migration path for old toggle schema. add compatibility layer that maps old preview fields to new cohort structure.
Kai: ack. I'll open PR with implementation + console mocks. planning to run staging dry-run now, results in ~10m. tagging folks for follow-up: @Marta @Simon @Anya.
Marta: cheers, will watch the dashboard.
Simon: on call and watching.
ops-bot: dry-run complete: dr-1758765432. no significant deltas reported. metrics: preview.errors=0.02%, p95_delta=+3ms.
Anya: awesome — looks safe to increase to 0.5% for non-critical routes tomorrow.
Kai: will ship the PR and a small console tweak. thanks team! :tada:
